description: Six AI engineering students from Buenos Aires. Our name is a reminder: good tools make people wiser, they don't replace them. For Field Shift we asked an agronomist about a record El Niño year: "We all know the forecast already." So we built Cropilot, which uses NASA data to find the past seasons that started like this one. On the way: computer vision (U-Net) on NASA HLS imagery to map crops, a reinforcement-learning planner checked against an exact solver and a source-citing LLM assistant.
